Both clear Patterns.dev out of the Read later pile and, as the notice says, leave it in All bookmarks — which is exactly what I meant by clearing it out, and having Read later as its own section fits too.

Between the two, marking it done with the little circle to check off feels better to me — it reads like ticking something off a reading list, which is just how I think about that pile. The "Mark as read" button works the same way, but the checkmark feels the most natural.

So I'd go with the completion check.
